papers.title: Vibrational and electron-phonon coupling properties of \b{eta}-Ga2O3 from first-principles calculations: Impact on the mobility and breakdown field
papers.summary: The wide band gap semiconductor \b{eta}-Ga2O3 shows promise for applications in high-power and high-temperature electronics. The phonons of \b{eta}-Ga2O3 play a crucial role in determining its important material characteristics for these applications such as its thermal transport, carrier mobility, and breakdown voltage.
